## Made slowly, worn often.


Each piece at Forge & Fleur is shaped by hand, carrying subtle maker marks that tell a story of patience and intention. We believe jewellery should feel personal, never mass-produced.


From the first sketch to the final polish, every step is guided by care. The result is a collection of unique handcrafted jewelry gifts that become part of your everyday rhythm.






Hand-formed details





Small-batch materials





Gift-ready finishing touches









Every piece is signed by the maker and wrapped in a linen care pouch.















## Find Your Narrative


Every piece tells a story. Explore our curated collections designed for the moments that define us, crafted with intention and soul.





Products


















### Everyday Heirlooms


Quiet, essential pieces designed to be worn daily, gathering the patina of a life well-lived. Simple bands and subtle pendants that feel like second skin.












### Ceremony & Sentiment


Marking milestones with intention. Sculptural forms and meaningful talismans for gifting, celebration, and the chapters that shape us.












### Texture Studies


An exploration of surface and touch. Hammered, carved, and reticulated metals that capture light and celebrate the raw, elemental beauty of the maker's hand.









View curated pieces














## Crafted with Intention








### Considered Materials


We source recycled sterling silver, ethically mined gemstones, and conflict-free gold. Every element is chosen for its beauty and its story, ensuring your piece feels as good as it looks.









### Made in Small Batches


Each collection is crafted in limited runs to reduce waste and celebrate individuality. We never mass-produce, so your piece is as unique as the hands that shaped it.









### Packaging with Intention


From recycled paper boxes to organic cotton pouches, our packaging is designed to be kept, reused, or composted. No plastic, no excess — just a beautiful unboxing experience.









### Repair-Minded Care


We believe jewellery should last a lifetime. We offer complimentary cleaning, restringing, and minor repairs on every Forge & Fleur piece, keeping your heirlooms in circulation.

Whether you need gentle gift guidance, have a question about caring for your handmade pieces, or simply want help finding a meaningful treasure that speaks to the heart — we're here, ready to listen and assist.

# Where Every Piece Holds the Maker's Touch



At Forge & Fleur, we believe jewellery should carry a story you can feel. Each piece is shaped in our sunlit studio through patient, small-batch making — never mass-produced, never rushed. We celebrate the slight unevenness of a hand-forged curve, the quiet warmth of a brushed finish, and the quiet confidence that comes from wearing something made just for you.


Our process honors time-honored metalsmithing techniques paired with an eye for modern simplicity. From the first sketch to the final polish, every step is guided by thoughtful finishing and a deep respect for the materials we shape. The result is an heirloom-quality piece that feels both deeply personal and effortlessly wearable.

















Our Craft


## From Sketch to Treasure


Every piece of handmade jewellery for women at Forge & Fleur carries the quiet intention of its maker. Discover the four stages that transform raw materials into wearable art.







01








### Sketch & Source


Each design begins as a pencil drawing, inspired by organic forms and the natural world. We then source ethical gemstones and recycled metals, selecting every element for its unique character and provenance.







02








### Form & Texture


Using traditional metalsmithing techniques, we shape, hammer, and solder each component. The subtle textures — a brushed finish, a hammered surface — are created entirely by hand, ensuring no two pieces are ever identical.







03








### Finish by Hand


Every piece is polished, set, and inspected under natural light. Stone settings are checked for security, clasps are tested for smooth movement, and surfaces are refined until they feel as good as they look.







04







### Wrap with Care


Before it reaches you, each piece is nestled in recycled packaging with a handwritten note. We believe the unboxing should feel like a gift — even if the gift is for yourself.














## The Materials of Our Craft


Every piece begins with an intentional selection of elements chosen for their warmth, durability, and the way they feel against the skin.











### Warm Metals


We work primarily with sterling silver, brass, and 14k gold-fill — metals that develop a living patina over time. Each component is hand-forged, hammered, or cast in small batches, never mass-produced. The result is a piece that feels substantial yet soft, with a warmth that only hand-finishing can bring.











### Natural Textures


Texture is a quiet language in our work. We incorporate raw silk cords, hand-spun linen wraps, and smooth river-worn stones into select designs. These elements ground each piece in the natural world, creating a sensory experience that goes beyond the visual — inviting touch, curiosity, and a deeper connection to the handmade.











### Keepsake Packaging


Receiving a piece from Forge & Fleur is an experience in itself. Every order is wrapped in a reusable linen pouch, tucked into a hand-stamped kraft box, and finished with a sprig of dried lavender. We believe the unboxing should feel as intentional as the piece inside — a moment of quiet ritual that honours both the maker and the wearer.






















## Caring for Your Handmade Jewellery


Each piece from Forge & Fleur is crafted with intention, using natural metals and delicate finishes that deserve mindful care. With a few simple rituals, your unique handcrafted jewelry gifts will retain their beauty for generations, developing a character that is entirely your own.


Ask Our Studio
→







- ### Keep Away from Harsh Chemicals Remove your jewellery before applying perfumes, lotions, or household cleaners. Chemicals can accelerate tarnishing and damage delicate finishes.

- ### Store Separately Keep each piece in its own soft pouch or a lined jewellery box to prevent scratches and tangling. Silver and gold-filled pieces benefit from anti-tarnish strips.

- ### Polish Gently Use the provided polishing cloth with light, even strokes. Avoid liquid dips or abrasive cleaners, which can remove intentional patinas and soften textured details.

- ### Remove Before Swimming Chlorine and saltwater are corrosive to precious metals and can permanently damage gemstones. Always remove your pieces before entering a pool, hot tub, or the ocean.

- ### Allow Natural Patina If desired, embrace the gentle darkening that comes with wear. A natural patina adds depth and tells the story of your handmade jewellery for women — a living finish unique to you.

# Gifts with a pulse.


### Handmade jewellery carries the rhythm of the maker — a heartbeat in metal and stone. Perfect for birthdays, anniversaries, quiet celebrations, bridesmaids, or simply because you deserve something made just for you.


Explore the Collection
Our Story  →









## Curated for Every Occasion


Find the perfect piece for every story and every style. Our gift guide celebrates the moments that matter, with unique handcrafted jewelry gifts designed to be cherished.








### For Everyday Wearers


Subtle, lightweight designs that become a seamless part of daily life. Think delicate chains, tiny studs, and stacking rings that whisper elegance without asking for attention.

Daily Essentials






### For Milestone Moments


Celebrate life's big chapters with pieces that carry meaning. Birthdays, anniversaries, or new beginnings deserve artisan jewelry US craftsmanship that tells a story forever.

Statement Pieces






### For Minimalists


Clean lines and understated beauty for those who believe less is more. Each piece is a quiet study in form, perfect for the discerning lover of ethical handmade jewelry online.

Clean Edit






### For Texture Lovers


Hammered finishes, raw crystals, and organic shapes that beg to be touched. These tactile treasures celebrate the handmade process in every ridge and contour.

Tactile Art






### For Someone Who Has Everything


The unexpected treasure. One-of-a-kind artisan pieces with uncommon gemstones or sculptural silhouettes that even the most seasoned collector hasn't seen before.

Rare Finds










## Find the Perfect Piece,Every Time


Choosing a handmade gift is an act of care. Our advisory team helps you match metal, finish, and meaning to the person you're celebrating — no guesswork, just thoughtful curation.










### Match Their Rhythm


Does their style lean daily-minimal or occasion-bold? We'll help you read the clues — from their wardrobe palette to their existing jewellery — so every piece feels instinctively theirs.











### Choose a Finish They Already Love


From warm brass to cool sterling silver, finish is everything. Share a photo of their favourites and we'll identify the metal tone and texture that will slot seamlessly into their collection.











### Add Meaning Through Presentation


Every Forge & Fleur piece arrives with a handwritten note and artisan wrapping. Tell us the story you want to tell — a milestone, a memory, a quiet 'I see you' — and we'll craft the unboxing around it.





Ask for Gift Advice



















## Words from the Heart








The moment I opened the box, I knew this wasn't just another piece of jewellery. The hand-stamped texture of the silver cuff caught the light in a way that felt alive — imperfect in the most beautiful way. My sister cried when she saw it, and it has become her daily talisman. The packaging alone felt like a ceremony, with dried botanicals tucked into the tissue and a handwritten note that made the whole experience feel deeply personal.


— Elena M., Portland








I bought the hammered gold stacking rings for my partner's birthday, and they are even more luminous in person. Each ring has its own subtle character — the artisan's hand is genuinely present in every curve. She wears them every day and says they make her feel seen, as if someone truly considered the person who would wear them. The olive-green suede pouch they arrived in now lives permanently on her dresser.


— Sam R., Brooklyn








There is a warmth to these pieces that you simply don't find in mass-produced jewellery. I ordered the freshwater pearl drop earrings for my mother, and the pearls have this soft, organic lustre — no two are identical. She told me it was the most thoughtful gift she's received in years, and I think it's because the jewellery itself carries a story. You can feel the maker's intention. Every detail, from the wax-sealed box to the care card, whispered quality.


— Priya K., Austin

## A Note from the Maker



Every piece of handmade jewellery carries a quiet story that begins long before it reaches you — in the warmth of the workshop, the rhythm of the tools, and the unhurried attention that only human hands can give. These small, deliberate marks are not imperfections; they are fingerprints of care, proof that your piece was shaped with patience rather than pressed by a machine.


I believe that slowness creates intimacy. When a necklace or ring is made slowly, it absorbs something of the moment — a mood, a season, a memory. Over time, it becomes part of your own daily ritual, a companion that gathers meaning with every wear. That is the quiet magic of artisan jewellery: it doesn’t just adorn; it remembers with you.

Tools

Time-honoured tools meet modern hands. Every curve and clasp is shaped with intention.










Care

Texture

We celebrate the imperfect beauty of hammered metal and raw stone—no two pieces are ever the same.

## Frequently Asked Questions


Everything you need to know about our handmade jewellery, care, and gifting.




01


### Why does each handmade piece look slightly different from the photos?


Every piece at Forge & Fleur is crafted by hand, which means no two are exactly alike. Slight variations in texture, finish, and stone placement are the hallmark of artisan jewellery — they're not flaws, but proof that a real maker shaped your piece with care and intention.




02


### How should I care for my handmade jewellery?


Keep your pieces away from water, lotions, and perfumes. Store them in the soft pouch or box they arrive in, and gently polish with the included cloth. Sterling silver may develop a natural patina over time — many of our customers treasure this deepening character.




03


### Is gift packaging included?


Yes. Every order arrives in our signature Forge & Fleur gift box with a soft interior pillow, tied with a linen ribbon. A handwritten note card is included — simply add your message at checkout. It's ready to give the moment it lands on your doorstep.




04


### How long does it take to receive my order?


Because each piece is made to order, please allow 5–10 business days for creation before shipping. You'll receive a confirmation email with tracking as soon as your jewellery is on its way. Rush orders may be available — reach out to us directly.




05


### What materials do you use?


We work primarily with ethically sourced sterling silver, 14k gold-fill, and solid brass. Our gemstones are hand-selected from small-scale suppliers who share our commitment to traceability. Every material is chosen for both beauty and longevity.




06


### I'm choosing a gift — how do I pick the right piece?


Think about the person's daily rituals. Do they wear mostly silver or gold tones? Do they prefer quiet, minimal shapes or pieces with a story? Our collection is designed to layer and evolve — a simple pendant or stud is always a beautiful place to begin. If you're unsure, our gift guide or a quick note to us can help.










## Let's Stay in Touch


We're here to help you find the perfect piece, answer any questions, and ensure your treasures last a lifetime.









### General Inquiries


Have a question about a design, a custom order, or just want to say hello? We'd love to hear from you. We typically respond within 24 hours on weekdays.









### Gift Guidance


Looking for the perfect handmade jewellery gift? Let us know the occasion and a little about the recipient, and we'll curate a selection of unique handcrafted jewelry gifts just for you.









### Care & Repair


Your artisan pieces are designed to be treasured. We're happy to advise on care, cleaning, and repairs to keep your ethical handmade jewelry online looking its best for years.

# Return Policy


Last Updated: 7/24/2026



At Forge & Fleur, we want you to be satisfied with your purchase. This policy outlines your rights for returns and refunds.


## 1. Return Window


You may return most items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund.


- Items must be unused and in original condition

- Items must be in original packaging

- Receipt or proof of purchase required




## 2. Non-Returnable Items


- Perishable goods

- Custom or personalized items

- Digital products and opened software

- Personal hygiene products that have been opened




## 3. Damaged or Defective Items


If you receive a damaged or defective item, contact us within 48 hours for a full refund including shipping costs.


## 4. Contact Us



For returns or questions:


Email: [business_email]


Phone: [business_phone]


Address: [business_address]

# Privacy Policy



Last Updated:  7/24/2026



Forge & Fleur ("Company", "we", "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use and protect your information when you use our website [business_website] ("Service").


## 1. Information Collection


We may collect the following types of information:


- Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number and address

- Technical Information: IP address, browser type, operating system and website usage data

- Cookies: Information stored on your computer to improve user experience




## 2. Use of Information


We use the collected information for the following purposes:


- Providing requested services

- Improving service and user experience

- Contacting you regarding our services

- Compliance with legal requirements




## 3. Information Sharing


We do not sell, rent or share your personal information with third parties, except in the following cases:


- With your explicit consent

- When required by law

- To protect our rights or user safety

- With service providers who assist in operating the service (under confidentiality agreements)




## 4. User Rights


In accordance with Israeli Privacy Protection Law 1981, you have the following rights:


- Right to access personal information stored about you

- Right to correct inaccurate or incomplete information

- Right to delete personal information in certain circumstances

- Right to object to information processing for marketing purposes

- Right to file a complaint with the Data Protection Authority




## 5. Cookies


Our website uses cookies to improve user experience. You can manage cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect website functionality.


## 6. Information Security


We implement reasonable security measures to protect your information, including encryption, firewalls and restricted access control. However, no transmission or storage method is 100% secure.


## 7. Policy Changes


We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Material changes will be posted on the website with 30 days advance notice.



## 8. Contact Information


For questions or requests regarding this privacy policy, please contact us:


- Company: Forge & Fleur

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: [business_phone]

- Address: [business_address]



Data Protection Authority: For complaints, you may contact the Data Protection Authority at the Ministry of Justice

# Accessibility Statement



Last updated:  July 24, 2026



Forge & Fleur is committed to making our services accessible to all users. We strive to implement the Israeli Standard (TI 5568) based on WCAG 2.1 Level AA guidelines.


Accessibility Level: AA (Israeli Standard TI 5568)



## 1. Accessibility Policy


We believe in equal rights and the right of every person to receive information and services independently and equally. This website was designed and built with special emphasis on accessibility for people with disabilities.


## 2. Accessibility Arrangements on the Site


- Keyboard navigation support

- Screen reader compatibility

- Appropriate color contrast

- Flexible and scalable font sizes

- Descriptive image alt text

- Hierarchical heading structure

- Clear and descriptive links

- Support for 200% zoom without content loss





### WCAG 2.1 Compliance


The website complies with WCAG 2.1 Level AA, which includes:


- Perceivable: Information is presented in ways users can perceive

- Operable: Interface components are operable

- Understandable: Information and user interface are understandable

- Robust: Content can be interpreted by a variety of technologies





## 3. Supported Assistive Technologies


- NVDA (Windows)

- JAWS (Windows)

- VoiceOver (Mac/iOS)

- TalkBack (Android)

- Dragon NaturallySpeaking

- Switch navigation




## 4. Accessibility Testing


The website has been tested using:


- Automated accessibility testing tools

- Manual testing with screen readers

- Keyboard-only navigation

- Color contrast verification

- Testing with users with disabilities




## 5. Continuous Improvements


We are continuously working to improve the accessibility of our website and update it according to technological developments and user feedback.



## 6. Contact and Feedback


If you encounter an accessibility issue on the site or need assistance, please contact us:


- Company: Forge & Fleur

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: [business_phone]



Response time: We respond to accessibility inquiries within 3 business days and work to resolve issues within 10 business days.

# Terms of Use



Last updated:  July 24, 2026



Use of this site constitutes agreement to the terms outlined below. Please read carefully before use.



## 1. Definitions


- "Company" - Forge & Fleur

- "User" - Anyone who browses or uses the site

- "Services" - E-commerce / Handmade Jewellery provided through the site




## 2. Description of Services


Forge & Fleur provides E-commerce / Handmade Jewellery through the site. The services are subject to the terms detailed in this document and may change from time to time.


## 3. Terms of Use


Use of the site is conditional on compliance with the following terms:


- Use of the site for lawful purposes only

- No interference with site operations or other users

- No uploading of offensive, illegal, or harmful content

- Respect for copyright and intellectual property rights

- No actions that may compromise site security




## 4. User Obligations


- Providing accurate and truthful information during registration or ordering

- Maintaining confidentiality of account access details

- Immediate notification of any unauthorized account use

- Updating personal information as needed




## 5. Payment and Refund Policy


If services include payment:


- Payments are processed through secure and encrypted systems

- Prices include applicable taxes as required by law

- Right to cancel will be in accordance with consumer protection laws

- Refunds will be processed within 14 business days of cancellation approval




## 6. Limitation of Liability


Services are provided "as is" without warranty of any kind. The Company will not be liable for indirect, consequential, or special damages arising from use of the site, except where required by law.


## 7. Copyright and Intellectual Property


All content on the site, including text, images, design, and code, is protected by copyright owned by Forge & Fleur. Reproduction, distribution, or commercial use of content is prohibited without written permission.


## 8. Privacy


Collection and use of personal information is subject to our Privacy Policy. Use of the site constitutes agreement to the Privacy Policy as detailed separately.


## 9. Changes to Terms of Use


The Company may change these terms of use at any time. Material changes will be posted on the site with 30 days advance notice. Continued use after changes constitutes agreement to the new terms.


## 10. Service Termination


The Company may suspend or limit service at any time, including in cases of terms of use violations. In case of service termination, relevant provisions will remain in effect.


## 11. Governing Law and Dispute Resolution


These terms of use are governed by applicable laws. Any disputes will be resolved in accordance with local jurisdiction, with preference given to arbitration or mediation where possible.


## 12. General Provisions


- If any portion of the terms is found invalid, remaining terms will remain in effect

- Non-enforcement of a right will not be considered a waiver

- These terms of use constitute the entire agreement between the parties





## 13. Contact Information


For questions or clarifications regarding the terms of use:


- Company: Forge & Fleur

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: [business_phone]

- Address: [business_address]
